description: Shows which of the user's Google Workspace, Atlassian and Notion accounts are connected, and gives a one-click link to connect each one that is not. Call it first when you do not know what is connected, and whenever a tool says a provider is not connected. Each provider's tools are only listed once it is connected. Pass service to get a link for that provider even when it is already connected, to add another account. The link is for the user to open in their browser: it works once and expires after ten minutes.

service.description: One provider to report on, with a link even when it is already connected. Omit it to report on all of them.

name: connect
